title: Looking to connect with algorithmic traders and trading bot developers
author: alexandre_derre
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m Alex. I’m part of a small group of people with backgrounds in finance, and we’re currently working on AI-powered trading tools and automated strategies.

We’re still in the building and testing phase, so I’m not here to sell anything or make unrealistic promises about guaranteed returns.

I’d mainly love to connect with people who are already working on trading bots, algorithmic trading,   
backtesting, risk management or live deployment. 

Especially people who have experienced the difference between a strategy that looks great on paper and one that actually works in real market conditions.

Our long-term idea is to build a platform where people could discover and compare different trading bots and automated strategies in a simple and transparent way.

Right now, we’re just looking to talk, learn, exchange ideas and potentially meet people who might be interested in joining or contributing to the project.  
Feel free to send me a message here, or reach out on Instagram: **@alexandre.derre** 👀
